title: Improve scanner evaluation metrics against pinned baseline
description: Improve scanner recall/precision on each layer against the pinned baseline performance. Gold is frozen; only scanner code changes. One task per layer gap in impact order: data-flows (0%), components (0.6%), data-items (27%), mentions (42%). Each slice: plan -> implement scanner code -> run scorecard -> diff vs baseline (recall up, precision not cratered) -> acceptance -> merge to develop -> update baseline record. Do not change gold. Do not merge to main.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
## Round wind-down (Sep 4 2026)

Eight scanner slices merged to develop since pinned baseline at 6d241f8 (#63–#71):

| Layer | Baseline (6d241f8) | develop after round | Δ |
|-------|-------------------|---------------------|---|
| mentions | 33/79 (41.8%) | 62/79 (78.5%) | +29 |
| data-items | 38/140 (27.1%) | 43/140 (30.7%) | +5 |
| components | 3/519 (0.6%) | 136/519 (26.2%) | +133 |
| data-flows | 0/158 (0%) | 20/158 (12.7%) | +20 |

All four layers improved; no layer regressed. Components and data-flows moved from near-zero to meaningful recall. Mentions improved substantially in the final slice (#71). Data-items improved modestly (+5 from Ruby side effects); the 60+ target requires Phase 2 rollup work (new task).

Merged PRs: #63 enable flow metric, #64 flow_canonical round-trip, #65 pin baseline, #66 intra-component lineage, #67 widen flows, #68 component identity, #69 Ruby analyzer, #70 Ruby flows, #71 PII alias matching.

**Stopping point:** Epic paused here. Next round should start with data-items Phase 2 (rollup/assignment collision fix) before more pattern work.

right_now_summary: All scanner layers improved; the next work targets data-items rollup and assignment collisions.
